events.title: 대통령령 제1429호 국립학교설치령 일부개정 공포
observed_by: National Law Information Center historical text
events.finding: Article 3 added two special graduate schools at SNU, Public Administration and Public Health, for advanced university purposes and training personnel for administrative agencies and public-health work.
events.attribution_limit: Do not infer drafting/origination from promulgation form. Cabinet and Ministry proposal records are still required.

events.title: 제1429호의 행정대학원·보건대학원 설치 조항 시행
events.finding: The decree's general effective date was 1959-04-01. This separates the 1959-01-13 promulgation/founding-date convention from the statutory effective date.
events.attribution_limit: Institutional histories may use 1959-01-13 as establishment date; legal effect date is 1959-04-01. Preserve both rather than silently collapsing them.

events.title: 서울대 보건대학원 교육 실행층
observed_by: Korean Society for Preventive Medicine history
events.finding: Professional-society history records a 1959 preventive-medicine course at the new Graduate School of Public Health and associates 명주완 with it.

correction_note: Pass 131 left the exact decree number open. Pass 132 resolves that narrow legal-identity question as Presidential Decree No. 1429. It also shows that Public Administration and Public Health were expressly created together in Article 3. The exact decree does not itself establish the separate nursing-department change as the same legal clause; that linkage remains to be checked against Annex 1 and SNU records.
